shipped_rows.title_o: The influence of colour on memory performance: A review
shipped_rows.outcome_quote: Contrary to the original hypothesis, Kruskal-Wallis tests revealed no significant effects of colour priming on memory span, χ²(2) = 0.808, p = .668
